doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9, rules 5, 6 and 9, FR-002: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/unclosed-pipeline.owm at ad1a4680a, unchanged. The pipeline of Kettle opens its block on line 6 (its OPEN token starts at the line ending of line 5) and never closes it: its two components are its children, the two lines after them do not parse inside the block and are skipped, each reported as fbl.unparsed-text, as the tool passes over those two lines too, and the block ends at the end of the body, reported as fbl.unclosed-block at line 5. The skipped lines are kept and read as nothing else.

steps.doc: An add into the pipeline, whose block is not closed, is refused and writes nothing.
steps.refused: The block is not closed, so nothing can be added to it.
steps.expect:
title Unclosed pipeline
anchor User [0.9, 0.5]
component Kettle [0.5, 0.4]
User->Kettle
pipeline Kettle
{
  component Electric [0.6]
  component Gas [0.3]
component Power [0.1, 0.7]
Kettle->Power
